sections.heading: Legislative Discussions on Gasoline
paragraphs: According to Ammon News, the Lower House is set to discuss a quality assurance bill. Additionally, the body will address gasoline complaints during these discussions.

sections.heading: Price Increases in Kyrgyzstan
paragraphs: According to open.kg, gasoline prices have risen in Kyrgyzstan. This report also notes that pension increases have been promised during the same period.

sections.heading: AI-95 Price Surge
paragraphs: According to Акчabar, the price of AI-95 gasoline has risen by 24 per cent over the past month. The source questions whether an increase in OPEC+ production will assist the situation.

faq.q: What legislative actions are being taken regarding gasoline?
faq.a: According to Ammon News, the Lower House is scheduled to discuss a quality assurance bill and address gasoline complaints.

faq.q: How have gasoline prices changed recently?
faq.a: According to open.kg, gasoline prices have risen in Kyrgyzstan. Specifically, Акчabar reports that AI-95 has increased in price by 24 per cent over the past month.

faq.q: What factors might influence future prices?
faq.a: According to Акчabar, there is speculation on whether an increase in OPEC+ production will help the situation regarding rising prices.
